nodes.text:
Viral 🧵 
I'm going to talk literally about viruses in this thread. We have had a recent upsurge in news reports/videos about HMPV infections. HMPV stands for Human MetaPneumoVirus. As the name suggests, it affects the respiratory tract.

nodes.author: indiaemerges
nodes.text: The virus is well known amongst the medical and scientific community around the world since about early 2000s. The viral infection has flu like symptoms and is mostly exacerbated in children under the age of 5 or much older adults (>65) with a weak immune system.

nodes.author: indiaemerges
nodes.text: Almost all children have been exposed to this virus by the age of 5, just like the influenza virus. It is also a seasonal virus like the flu virus, peaking in winter and early spring. So why is it suddenly in the news if it causes mostly common cold like symptoms?

nodes.author: indiaemerges
nodes.text: Well, two reasons. First is after COVID, we as a planet have become better and more efficient at detecting viruses and randomised sequencing of infections. Second, China appears to have had an increase in infections this year, but the increase in not dramatic, statistically.

nodes.author: indiaemerges
nodes.text: So, all in all, there's no cause for concern despite the fact that we do not have a flu like vaccine against HMPV. Generally, a combination of drugs that manage the symptoms suffice. This is not remotely like COVID. We can all relax.

nodes.author: indiaemerges
nodes.text: Finally, if you are worried about the recent stories about viral infections, AMA.
